research_question: Can an adversarial individual-stock conditional-moment SDF produce a strong and temporally stable teacher without portfolio targets in training?
training_observations: individual stock excess returns and lagged Structured Core-92 characteristics

architecture.critic_output: month-wise centered and standardized bounded instruments

game: The critic maximizes normalized individual-stock conditional Euler errors. The SDF network minimizes the same errors through five characteristic-managed factor returns, with factor-diversity and concentration regularization.
validation_selection_rule: On 2000-2009, require both HJ and mean absolute alpha no worse than FF5 plus momentum on each external asset family; among feasible critic dimensions choose the lowest combined alpha, breaking ties by HJ.
development_promotion_rule: On 2010-2019 require at least five-percent HJ and alpha improvements versus FF5 plus momentum on combined assets and each external family, positive improvements in both five-year halves, and factor-span Sharpe no lower than the benchmark.
boundary: This is a new strong-teacher architecture pilot, not a compression result. Failure triggers an architecture review; passing triggers five seeds before any bottleneck experiment.
